description.value: Bodega is a Spanish-influenced wine and tapas bar in downtown Victoria, specializing in one of Canada's largest Sherry menus alongside rotating local and Spanish charcuterie, cheeses, and specialty wines. The kitchen draws on Mediterranean and tapas traditions with a strong emphasis on Spanish producers. The restaurant operates on a walk-in, first-come basis with a text-based waitlist when full.

enrichment_extras.reasoning: The website at bodegabar.ca is accessible and confirms the business is an operating wine and tapas bar at 1210 Broad St, Victoria BC, with contact phone 778-406-1210 visible on the site. OSM tags confirm the address and website URL. No bike parking, washroom, water refill, or cyclist-specific amenity information appears anywhere in the website content or OSM tags, so those fields are set to null per the evidence-only rule.
concerns: OSM name is 'Bodega Wine & Tapas Bar' but website title reads 'Bodega - Wine & Tapa Bar' (singular 'Tapa') — minor discrepancy, OSM name retained per instructions.
No phone number in OSM; phone 778-406-1210 sourced from website only.
enrichment_extras.recommended_status_reason: Real, operating, publicly accessible bar and restaurant in downtown Victoria confirmed by active website with current content.
enrichment_extras.notes: Website explicitly states the business is not affiliated with any other restaurant named Bodega and is located only in Victoria BC.
